meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当用户要求重构代码时,Claude会先确认需求和范围,再分析代码库、找出相关文件与依赖,评估测试覆盖,制定重构计划,然后逐步修改代码并在每一步运行测试确认没弄坏东西,最后做整体检查并总结改动。
howto.when: 当你说出 “refactor”、“refactoring”、“cleanup” 等触发词,或要求重构、整理、简化代码时触发。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 里的验证逻辑拆成独立模块
say.note: 会先分析依赖再逐步重构并验证

say.text: 用安全策略重构 AuthService 类
say.note: 会先评估测试覆盖,再按计划改造

say.text: 清理项目里所有重复代码
say.note: 会先确认范围,再制定计划执行

howto.what_en: On a refactor request, Claude confirms intent, maps the codebase, assesses tests, plans, then applies changes stepwise with tests after each step, finishing with a full suite run and summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says keywords like 'refactor', 'refactoring', 'cleanup', etc., or asks to restructure, simplify, or modernize code.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: It will analyze dependencies then refactor step by step.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class using the safe strategy.
say_en.note: It assesses test coverage before planning changes.

say_en.text: Clean up all duplicate code in the project.
say_en.note: It will clarify scope first, then plan and execute.
